<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version2/core" level="3" version="2">

    <listOfUnitDefinitions>
      <unitDefinition id="minute">
        <listOfUnits>
          <unit kind="second" exponent="1" scale="0" multiplier="60"/>
        </listOfUnits>
      </unitDefinition>
    </listOfUnitDefinitions>
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="C" spatialDimensions="0" size="1" units="dimensionless" constant="true"/>

      <parameter id="K" value="0.7" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="S" value="2" units="dimensionless" constant="false"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfRules>
      <rateRule variable="S">
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <apply>
                <minus/>
                <ci> V </ci>

              <ci> S </ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <ci> K </ci>
              <ci> S </ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </math>
      </rateRule>
    </listOfRules>
